name: video-to-mp3-desktop
description: Applicazione desktop offline per convertire video in MP3 (Electron + Express + Python/PyAV).

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.make:win: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.make:win:arm64: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform win32 --arch arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --arm64 --publish never
scripts.make:mac: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform darwin && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --publish never
scripts.make:mac:arm64: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform darwin --arch arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.make:mac:x64: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.make:linux: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform linux --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.make:linux:arm64: node scripts/prepare-resources.js --platform linux --arch arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux --arm64 --publish never
